source_request: Excel Inflow v3.7 repair handover dated 2026-08-17

custody.confidentiality_rule: Screenshots and company-specific derived data remain outside this public repository; only neutral invariants and fixtures may be committed.

baseline_gate.filtered_handover_claim: 63/63 repository-local tests passed after seven external tests were temporarily removed from the registry; that receipt is not the unfiltered 71-test result.

first_attempt.reason: The standard-maximal-v2 fixture lacks the production source and authority contracts required by compile_skill_release.

Forecast Waterfall sets brokerDisabled and removes broker ownership/consumption
producer emits demand /2.0 while run_constitution_graph and broker pipeline require /1.0
compiler authors visible EBITDA proxy labels
unmatched non-empty descriptions default to other_debt

p0_root_cause_map.earliest_responsible_layer: statement hierarchy plus historical/forecast aggregate ownership compilation
p0_root_cause_map.repair_boundary: typed semantic graph and compiler ownership selection; never emitted cells

p0_root_cause_map.symptom: Forecast Waterfall disables compatible broker evidence
p0_root_cause_map.repair_boundary: selection/consumption doctrine before forecast authority materialization

p0_root_cause_map.symptom: fresh v2 broker demand cannot traverse v1-only consumers
p0_root_cause_map.repair_boundary: one version-aware reader normalized to a canonical internal node form

p0_root_cause_map.symptom: protected cash-flow totals accept carry-forward forecast authority
p0_root_cause_map.earliest_responsible_layer: protected cash-flow identity and aggregate ownership compilation
p0_root_cause_map.repair_boundary: semantic row graph/row plan formula authority

p0_root_cause_map.repair_boundary: acquisition plan/runtime row identity; never physical row numbers

p0_root_cause_map.repair_boundary: typed transaction graph plus solver/emitter contract

implementation_order: broker control semantics and v2 continuity
full cohort, package build and installed-host evidence

risks.finding: Issuer-defined Product Revenue is delivered as a historical hardcode even where its complete reported children reconcile to it.
risks.evidence: Workbook values and Show-Formulas views show Product Sales + Alliance Revenue = Product Revenue, while Product Revenue remains a blue source input.
risks.acceptance_criterion: When complete reported children reconcile in all historical periods, the visible parent is a formula, the filed total is retained as reconciliation evidence, and a mutation to hardcode the parent fails.

implementation.invariant: When complete reported children reconcile in all historical periods, the visible parent is a formula, the filed total is retained as reconciliation evidence, and a mutation to hardcode the parent fails.

risks.finding: Product Revenue and its children each own independent forecasts.
risks.evidence: The forecast columns apply historical-delta formulas to Product Sales, Alliance Revenue and Product Revenue simultaneously.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Exactly one forecast mode is selected: children-own and parent sums, or parent-owns and children are blank/captured.

implementation.invariant: Exactly one forecast mode is selected: children-own and parent sums, or parent-owns and children are blank/captured.

risks.finding: The visible control Forecast Waterfall disables broker consumption in the current compiler.
risks.evidence: case_compiler.mjs sets brokerDisabled when broker_case === "Forecast Waterfall", removes broker ownership and iterates zero pack metrics. The delivered workbook then uses historical inference despite three broker tabs.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Selecting Forecast Waterfall consumes compatible broker authorities or explicitly records rejection; it never disables them merely because of the control label.

implementation.invariant: Selecting Forecast Waterfall consumes compatible broker authorities or explicitly records rejection; it never disables them merely because of the control label.

risks.finding: The producer emits pre-broker demand v2 while important consumers remain v1-only.
risks.evidence: run_attachment_evidence_pipeline.py emits /2.0; run_constitution_graph.mjs, run_broker_pipeline.py and a path in broker_terminal_recovery.py require /1.0.
risks.acceptance_criterion: A fresh v2 graph passes the complete producer-consumer path through selected authority and workbook emission.

implementation.invariant: A fresh v2 graph passes the complete producer-consumer path through selected authority and workbook emission.

risks.finding: The product explicitly authors the visible labels EBITDA proxy and EBITDA proxy margin.
risks.evidence: Source anchor in case_compiler.mjs and workbook face.
risks.acceptance_criterion: The face uses EBITDA / Adjusted EBITDA according to actual economic definition; derivation status stays in provenance.

implementation.invariant: The face uses EBITDA / Adjusted EBITDA according to actual economic definition; derivation status stays in provenance.

risks.finding: The EBITDA bridge can add impairment because the D&A candidate accepts a combined depreciation, amortisation and impairment row.
risks.evidence: Workbook bridge uses the combined row; compiler candidate regex matches depreciation/amortisation and does not reject impairment.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Pure EBITDA adds only compatible D&A; impairment is a separate adjustment and is included only in an explicitly labelled adjusted measure.

implementation.invariant: Pure EBITDA adds only compatible D&A; impairment is a separate adjustment and is included only in an explicitly labelled adjusted measure.

risks.finding: Company-adjusted EBIT / Core Operating profit is not represented as a distinct concept.
risks.evidence: The current role set collapses reported operating profit, EBIT and adjusted measures too aggressively.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Reported EBIT, adjusted EBIT, reported EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA are separately typed and bridged.

implementation.invariant: Reported EBIT, adjusted EBIT, reported EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA are separately typed and bridged.

risks.finding: A body row with unresolved numeric values is proposed as a header.
risks.evidence: case_source_proposer.mjs valueLess(row) returns true when values are absent and proposeSection sets header:true; workbook shows fair-value movements and share-award payments as headings.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Header status requires positive structural evidence; unresolved body rows remain body rows with unresolved values.

implementation.invariant: Header status requires positive structural evidence; unresolved body rows remain body rows with unresolved values.

risks.finding: Net cash outflow from investing is carried forward from the prior year instead of summing current-period investing rows.
risks.evidence: Show-Formulas screenshots show J82=I82, K82=J82, L82=K82 while capex and interest received change.
risks.acceptance_criterion: CFI is a same-period formula over top-level investing members in every historical, forecast, adjustment and pro forma period.

implementation.invariant: CFI is a same-period formula over top-level investing members in every historical, forecast, adjustment and pro forma period.

risks.finding: Net cash before financing activities is carried forward rather than calculated as CFO + CFI.
risks.evidence: Show-Formulas screenshots show J84=I84 etc.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Cash before financing is a same-period formula and cannot receive direct forecast authority.

implementation.invariant: Cash before financing is a same-period formula and cannot receive direct forecast authority.

risks.finding: Acquisition of subsidiaries, net of cash acquired, references the Exchange rate effects row.
risks.evidence: Targeted crop shows forecast row 65 linking to row 101.
risks.acceptance_criterion: The row is zero when acquisition is off and links exactly once to transaction consideration when on; no FX-row dependency exists.

implementation.invariant: The row is zero when acquisition is off and links exactly once to transaction consideration when on; no FX-row dependency exists.

risks.finding: Working-capital parent and detail rows remain forecast-live together.
risks.evidence: Workbook forecasts receivables, inventory and payables while Change in working capital also exists as parent.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Default overlay mode forecasts one parent working-capital line; historical children remain visible and forecast children are blank/captured.

implementation.invariant: Default overlay mode forecasts one parent working-capital line; historical children remain visible and forecast children are blank/captured.

risks.finding: Detailed debt issuance / repayment / RCF rows remain forecast-live on the cash-flow face.
risks.evidence: Workbook carries detailed financing rows rather than one top-level Change in Debt forecast tied to the schedule.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Instrument detail lives in the debt schedule; cash-flow forecast uses one schedule-linked Change in Debt line.

implementation.invariant: Instrument detail lives in the debt schedule; cash-flow forecast uses one schedule-linked Change in Debt line.

risks.finding: RCF draw and repayment are omitted from the visible financing subtotal.
risks.evidence: The displayed CFF SUM ranges skip the RCF rows.
risks.acceptance_criterion: RCF movements enter CFF, net change in cash, closing cash and debt exactly once.

implementation.invariant: RCF movements enter CFF, net change in cash, closing cash and debt exactly once.

risks.finding: Event-driven rows recur through carry-forward or trend.
risks.evidence: Disposal gains, contingent consideration, NCI payments, hedge movements and other event rows repeat in forecast.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Non-recurring events cannot use carry-forward, historical average or historical trend without explicit recurrence evidence.

implementation.invariant: Non-recurring events cannot use carry-forward, historical average or historical trend without explicit recurrence evidence.

risks.finding: Cash tax paid is silently linked to P&L tax expense.
risks.evidence: case_compiler.mjs fallback wiring links cash_tax_paid to tax_expense; workbook mirrors the tax charge.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Cash tax uses source / guidance / broker / driver authority; P&L tax fallback is explicit and labelled.

implementation.invariant: Cash tax uses source / guidance / broker / driver authority; P&L tax fallback is explicit and labelled.

risks.finding: A source artefact row labelled F-5 appears on the visible model face.
risks.evidence: Workbook screenshot.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Footnote and source-reference tokens are retained in provenance, not rendered as economic rows.

implementation.invariant: Footnote and source-reference tokens are retained in provenance, not rendered as economic rows.

risks.finding: Cash generated from operations bypasses the visible working-capital parent and sums child rows directly.
risks.evidence: Workbook formula omits the parent and references the children.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Downstream identities consume the selected parent authority and do not bypass it.

implementation.invariant: Downstream identities consume the selected parent authority and do not bypass it.

risks.finding: Bonds, bank borrowings, overdrafts and the RCF are misclassified, many under Other Debt.
risks.evidence: Workbook debt schedule.
risks.earliest_responsible_layer: DCS classification and cross-layer enum mismatch.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Canonical class is consistent from extraction through display; unresolved material instruments are unclassified-review, never silently Other Debt.

implementation.invariant: Canonical class is consistent from extraction through display; unresolved material instruments are unclassified-review, never silently Other Debt.

risks.finding: The DCS classifier defaults every non-empty unmatched description to other_debt.
risks.evidence: propose_dcs_crosswalk.py classify_type returns other_debt on any remaining text.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Other Debt requires affirmative evidence; default is unclassified with a blocking/review receipt.

implementation.invariant: Other Debt requires affirmative evidence; default is unclassified with a blocking/review receipt.

risks.finding: Debt class vocabularies differ across layers.
risks.evidence: DCS emits fixed_bond/floating_loan while display/grouping recognises bond/senior_notes/term_loan/bank_debt.
risks.acceptance_criterion: One enum is used by extraction, model case, schedule, display and validator.

implementation.invariant: One enum is used by extraction, model case, schedule, display and validator.

risks.finding: Visible instrument names remain long legal/source strings and truncate before the useful distinguisher.
risks.evidence: Workbook schedule.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Face label is structured Type + rate/margin + maturity; full legal name and identifier remain in comments/provenance.

implementation.invariant: Face label is structured Type + rate/margin + maturity; full legal name and identifier remain in comments/provenance.

risks.finding: A universal debt-grouping helper is named and documented as CRH-specific.
risks.evidence: row_plan.mjs CRH_DEBT_GROUPS / crhDebtGroupKey.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Generic issuer-independent grouping functions replace company-named product logic.

implementation.invariant: Generic issuer-independent grouping functions replace company-named product logic.

risks.finding: Forecast lease liability falls to zero while lease principal repayments continue.
risks.evidence: Workbook net debt and cash flow.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Opening liability, additions, interest, principal and closing liability reconcile in each period.

implementation.invariant: Opening liability, additions, interest, principal and closing liability reconcile in each period.

risks.finding: Interest lineage validation only proves that a debt-row number appears somewhere in the formula.
risks.evidence: validate_dynamic_model.py tests str(plan[debt_row]) in formula.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Validator proves same instrument, opening/average balance, movements, rate, benchmark, FX, timing and sign.

implementation.invariant: Validator proves same instrument, opening/average balance, movements, rate, benchmark, FX, timing and sign.

risks.finding: RCF fees may be counted in instrument-modelled interest and again in gross interest expense.
risks.evidence: Visible formula ranges strongly suggest duplicate aggregation; zero fees hide the defect.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Non-zero fee mutation proves each RCF fee component enters gross interest once.

implementation.invariant: Non-zero fee mutation proves each RCF fee component enters gross interest once.

risks.finding: Lease interest is explicitly not separately modelled despite lease debt.
risks.evidence: Workbook interest schedule.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Lease interest is modelled or explicitly excluded with metric-basis disclosure and consistent debt treatment.

implementation.invariant: Lease interest is modelled or explicitly excluded with metric-basis disclosure and consistent debt treatment.

risks.finding: Residual / unallocated interest is not controlled by a clear forecast authority.
risks.evidence: Workbook interest reconciliation.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Residual reconciles reported finance expense and receives an explicit forecast authority or zero.

implementation.invariant: Residual reconciles reported finance expense and receives an explicit forecast authority or zero.

risks.finding: Enterprise value, entry multiple and target EBITDA are all independently editable and visibly inconsistent.
risks.evidence: Acquisition control box: 10 EV, 10.0x, 500 EBITDA.
risks.earliest_responsible_layer: Acquisition input schema and control validation.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Only two inputs are primary; the third is calculated; units/currency are explicit and activation blocks on inconsistency.

implementation.invariant: Only two inputs are primary; the third is calculated; units/currency are explicit and activation blocks on inconsistency.

risks.finding: Adjustment and pro forma columns contain pervasive #VALUE! errors.
risks.evidence: Normal and Show-Formulas screenshots show errors across P&L, cash flow, debt, RCF and interest.
risks.earliest_responsible_layer: Central acquisition / RCF / interest join plus missing native error gate.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Acquisition On produces zero Excel errors and reconciles all transaction flows; Off/On/Off/On restores exactly.

implementation.invariant: Acquisition On produces zero Excel errors and reconciles all transaction flows; Off/On/Off/On restores exactly.

risks.finding: Target PBT is floored at zero in the acquisition logic.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Negative target PBT is modelled or the unsupported case blocks explicitly; no silent floor.

implementation.invariant: Negative target PBT is modelled or the unsupported case blocks explicitly; no silent floor.

risks.finding: The main validator inspects cached values and does not recalculate the workbook.
risks.evidence: validate_dynamic_model.py documents this blind spot; native Excel later exposes errors.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Final gate uses native Excel recalculation or equivalent external evidence and scans every relevant used cell.

implementation.invariant: Final gate uses native Excel recalculation or equivalent external evidence and scans every relevant used cell.

risks.finding: Native Excel restoration is manual and absence can still yield PASS_PENDING_MANUAL.
risks.evidence: Validator header and promotion receipt.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Development delivery clearly distinguishes pending-manual from pass; promotion cannot claim workbook validity without required native evidence.

implementation.invariant: Development delivery clearly distinguishes pending-manual from pass; promotion cannot claim workbook validity without required native evidence.

risks.finding: Forecast authority ledger verification compares stored hash to rebuilt expected hash without independently hashing the stored body.
risks.evidence: forecast_authority_ledger.mjs verifyForecastAuthorityLedger.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Verifier hashes actual stored body, hashes rebuilt expected body, and compares bodies and hashes independently.

implementation.invariant: Verifier hashes actual stored body, hashes rebuilt expected body, and compares bodies and hashes independently.

risks.finding: Missing source values can become numeric zero in parts of the pipeline.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit and historical behaviour.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Reported zero, dash, blank, N/A and unresolved are distinct; only explicit zero becomes zero.

implementation.invariant: Reported zero, dash, blank, N/A and unresolved are distinct; only explicit zero becomes zero.

risks.finding: Equal-rung authority selection can fall through to weak/stable identifier ordering.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Definition, period, units, freshness, confidence and completeness rank before stable ID.

implementation.invariant: Definition, period, units, freshness, confidence and completeness rank before stable ID.

risks.finding: A carrier proves its own source identity fields exist but does not compare them with the active installation identity.
risks.evidence: run_carrier.mjs verifyRunCarrier.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Resume requires active source commit, tree, closure, package mode and installation identity match, or an explicit migration receipt.

implementation.invariant: Resume requires active source commit, tree, closure, package mode and installation identity match, or an explicit migration receipt.

risks.finding: Package mode vocabulary conflicts: one path expects production while build/certification uses certified/development.
risks.evidence: source_identity.mjs and prior release audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: One package-mode enum and separate deployment-status enum are used consistently.

implementation.invariant: One package-mode enum and separate deployment-status enum are used consistently.

risks.finding: Certification hashes a conceptual closure and then mutates metadata inside that closure.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Build immutable package, hash it, then emit a separate external attestation; certified bytes never change.

implementation.invariant: Build immutable package, hash it, then emit a separate external attestation; certified bytes never change.

risks.finding: Source, runtime and package layers use competing closure definitions.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit and promotion receipt fields.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Distinct named identities exist for source tree, runtime code closure, complete package inventory, archive and installed package.

implementation.invariant: Distinct named identities exist for source tree, runtime code closure, complete package inventory, archive and installed package.

risks.finding: The vNext controller uses weaker subprocess handling than the robust process-tree helper already in the repository.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Timeout terminates descendants, verifies none survive, preserves logs and does not release state early.

implementation.invariant: Timeout terminates descendants, verifies none survive, preserves logs and does not release state early.

risks.finding: Subordinate paths invoke bare python3 rather than a top-level selected interpreter.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: One resolved Python executable is passed through every subprocess.

implementation.invariant: One resolved Python executable is passed through every subprocess.

risks.finding: A dead cross-host lease can remain live and strand a run.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Lease has heartbeat, expiry, host/session identity and auditable takeover.

implementation.invariant: Lease has heartbeat, expiry, host/session identity and auditable takeover.

risks.finding: The root trace span can mask unowned time and inflate classified coverage.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Coverage is computed from leaf work and explicit waits; gaps remain visible.

implementation.invariant: Coverage is computed from leaf work and explicit waits; gaps remain visible.

risks.finding: Local filing paths are not sufficiently constrained to approved attachment roots.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Canonical paths must remain under declared roots; symlink escapes, devices and non-regular files are rejected.

implementation.invariant: Canonical paths must remain under declared roots; symlink escapes, devices and non-regular files are rejected.

risks.finding: Official-domain trust and URL fetching are too caller-dependent and insufficiently bounded.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Independent allowlist authority, private-IP and rebinding protection, redirect revalidation, byte/time limits and content checks.

implementation.invariant: Independent allowlist authority, private-IP and rebinding protection, redirect revalidation, byte/time limits and content checks.

risks.finding: Statement extraction is page-local and type-insensitive for long/multi-page statements.
risks.evidence: Prior audit and workbook row-type failures.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Multi-page continuity, repeated-header removal, typed values, units and source order are preserved.

implementation.invariant: Multi-page continuity, repeated-header removal, typed values, units and source order are preserved.

risks.finding: Native broker PDF timeout is too aggressive and can force unnecessary degradation.
risks.evidence: Prior source audit.
risks.acceptance_criterion: Timeouts are evidence-size aware, supervised and observable; valid recovery is not prematurely abandoned.

implementation.invariant: Timeouts are evidence-size aware, supervised and observable; valid recovery is not prematurely abandoned.

risks.finding: Current CI and repair workflows do not provide durable read-only protection and recent workflows attempted to author product source.
risks.evidence: Current repair branch contains two source-writing workflows; all failed.
risks.acceptance_criterion: PR/main CI is read-only; product source is edited locally and pushed normally; obsolete write workflows are removed/archived.

implementation.invariant: PR/main CI is read-only; product source is edited locally and pushed normally; obsolete write workflows are removed/archived.

risks.finding: Workbook does not disclose selected broker houses, fallback count, rejected evidence or degraded mode.
risks.evidence: Workbook face.
risks.acceptance_criterion: A compact Build Identity / Quality panel states source identity, broker status, selected metrics, fallbacks and outstanding certification.

implementation.invariant: A compact Build Identity / Quality panel states source identity, broker status, selected metrics, fallbacks and outstanding certification.
